title: List all ID and district for clients that can only have the right to issue
question:
List all ID and district for clients that can only have the right to issue permanent orders or apply for loans.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Only the owner accounts have the right to issue permanent orders or apply for loans

prediction.sql:
SELECT c.XCL_009, c.XCL_012
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.XCL_014 = c.XCL_009
WHERE d.XCL_016 = 'OWNER'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM disp d2
    WHERE d2.XCL_014 = c.XCL_009 AND d2.XCL_016 <> 'OWNER'
  )
ORDER BY c.XCL_009;
